description: Update the existing VA page (pages/va.php) to use real API data instead of dummy data, split between Mandiri and Permata banks, and show breakdown by cabang. Also create Branchless page (pages/branchless.php) and QRIS Merchant page (pages/qris_merchant.php) with similar structure - each with trend charts, cabang breakdown table, and MoM/YOY comparison.
steps: Update pages/va.php: (a) Replace the dummy dummyVaData array with a real API call to ./api/transaksi/ with type 'va_detail_mandiri_permata' (new endpoint). (b) Keep the existing table structure showing Mandiri and Permata columns. (c) Add an area/cabang filter dropdown similar to layanan_digital.php pattern. (d) When kode_kantor is set (branch user), lock the filter. (e) Replace Chart.js with ApexCharts for consistency with other pages. (f) Add a breakdown table per cabang below the existing monthly table.

Add a new TransaksiController method getVaDetailMandiriPermata($input) that: (a) accepts harian_date (or date range awal/akhir), kode_kantor, korwil params, (b) queries the va table with kode_transaksi='320', (c) splits by Mandiri (norek_aba LIKE '%0001000001') vs Permata (norek_aba LIKE '%0001000004'), (d) groups by month for the monthly table, (e) also returns per-cabang breakdown with Mandiri/Permata split.

Create pages/branchless.php following the layanan_digital.php page pattern: (a) Title 'Branchless Banking', (b) Filter form with closing_date, harian_date, area/cabang, (c) Summary cards (total nominal, total trx, MoM growth), (d) Trend chart (ApexCharts area chart using tren_nominal_va endpoint with channel=BRANCHLESS), (e) Breakdown table by cabang (using detail_breakdown_transaksi endpoint with channel=BRANCHLESS), (f) YOY comparison section (using yoy_transaksi endpoint with channel=BRANCHLESS). (g) User branch lock pattern same as layanan_digital.php.

Create pages/qris_merchant.php following the same pattern as branchless.php but: (a) Title 'QRIS Merchant', (b) Use channel=QRIS for all API calls, (c) Same sections: summary cards, trend chart, breakdown table, YOY comparison.

Both branchless.php and qris_merchant.php should reuse the existing API endpoints (tren_nominal_va, detail_breakdown_transaksi, yoy_transaksi, summary_cards_transaksi) by passing the appropriate channel parameter - no new controller methods needed for these pages.
acceptance_criteria: pages/branchless.php exists and contains ApexCharts chart initialization and API calls with channel=BRANCHLESS
pages/qris_merchant.php exists and contains ApexCharts chart initialization and API calls with channel=QRIS
pages/va.php no longer uses the hardcoded dummyVaData array
The getVaDetailMandiriPermata method exists in TransaksiController and type is registered in routes
findings: All implementations completed successfully. Created getVaDetailMandiriPermata() in TransaksiController with monthly Mandiri/Permata VA breakdown. Registered va_detail_mandiri_permata route type. Replaced va.php with modern ApexCharts-based page using real API data. Created branchless.php and qris_merchant.php following layanan_digital.php patterns with BRANCHLESS and QRIS channel params respectively. All PHP syntax checks pass.
